briefdescription.para: Runs the parse and index jobs of the source files on a thread pool, and applies their results to the index.

detaileddescription.para: Each language row starts a build of its language on a subprocess. The library that the build writes is loaded for the family of the row. Each file row whose family has a loaded library gets one ParseJob. When a parse gives a document, each unit row that depends on the file gets an IndexJob. A job is one-shot: the pool runs it once, and the message thread removes it. A job works on values that its constructor receives, and it does not read the model. A job signals the message thread, which applies its result in handleAsyncUpdate. A parse result reaches the index only when the row still holds the same path, the file still has the modification time that the job read, and the family still has the library that the job used. An index job starts only when no parse job remains. The documents are keyed by the index of their path in paths.

The processor also answers the request rows of the model. Each request row runs the entry of events that its command names, in the listener that receives the row. The entry writes JSON to the result of the row. The lookups read the index in place, and they keep no state except the fuzzy finder slab of Query.
